reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread reply under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was **Southgate**.

The incident channel's history from 3 Sep 2025 shows it. Pree wrote that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes piled up beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see all of this himself.

I couldn't find a street address or site ID for Southgate in any channel or file Tobias has access to, so I told him that and suggested he ask Pree.
